strongest_angle: Major Hollywood labor unions including SAG-AFTRA and the Writers Guild of America jointly filed an amicus brief urging a federal judge to reject fair-use exemptions for AI model training.

key_facts.fact: SAG-AFTRA, the American Federation of Music, and the Writers Guild of America East and West jointly filed an amicus brief on a Thursday.
The Hollywood unions filed their amicus brief urging a federal judge to reject fair use exemptions for training AI models in an ongoing copyright battle involving OpenAI.
The joint amicus brief was also reported and syndicated through platforms like Yahoo News concerning the OpenAI copyright battle.
